title: Unjustifiable
summary: UNJUST'IFIABLE, adjective Not justifiable; that cannot be proved to be right; not to be vindicated or defended; as an unjustifiable motive or action.

inlines.v: UNJUST'IFIABLE, adjective Not justifiable; that cannot be proved to be right; not to be vindicated or defended; as an unjustifiable motive or action.
